start.description: when it starts: a local date and time in time_zone, such as 2026-10-02T10:00

end.description: when it ends, the same way; after start

time_zone.description: the IANA time zone the times are in, such as America/New_York; every read names the calendar's own

attendees.description: the guests' email addresses: Google puts the event on their calendars, and emails them only as notify says

notify.description: whom Google emails about the new event: none (the safe choice), externalOnly (guests who do not use Google Calendar), or all guests

distinct.description: only to make a second event with the same title and times, or one again after it was deleted: any short word, which becomes part of the event's id
